symptom: Distillation fractionnée appears beside but is not connected to Distillation; the predecessor is in a later era.
root_cause: The protected TECH-3A prerequisites omitted the vanilla semantic parent while compatibility retiming placed distillation in era 7.
correction: Move manufacturies to era 4 and distillation to era 5; retain the two protected prerequisites and add distillation to fractional_distillation in era 6.
expected_visual_effect: A direct adjacent three-stage chain across eras 4-6.
remaining_risk: Native auto-layout may order the three nodes horizontally apart because fractional_distillation still has three parents.

symptom: A late root and its one-node successor occupy an isolated column.
root_cause: Both vanilla compatibility nodes were mapped too late despite being mature/start-period practices.
correction: Move enclosure to era 4 and intensive_agriculture to era 5.
expected_visual_effect: A compact adjacent agricultural branch near the early production band.
remaining_risk: The native sorter controls horizontal placement.

symptom: A line crosses six era bands from Atmospheric engine to Water-tube boiler.
root_cause: The compatibility prerequisite pointed to the earliest steam ancestor rather than the immediate engineering predecessor.
correction: Replace atmospheric_engine with high_pressure_steam as the prerequisite.
expected_visual_effect: The boiler line crosses two eras instead of six.
remaining_risk: Other high_pressure_steam dependents can still influence horizontal routing.

root_cause: Broad vanilla ancestors survived after the TECH-3A chronology inserted closer semantic predecessors.
correction: Use hot_blast_smelting for steelworking and geological_surveying for prospecting.
expected_visual_effect: Two adjacent metallurgy/geology lines replace two full-height lines.
remaining_risk: The prospecting downstream family remains a large single-bridge chain and needs visual confirmation.

symptom: Mechanized farming is separated from Threshing machine by six eras.
root_cause: The vanilla terminal was left in era 10 after its ancestor was moved to era 4.
correction: Move mechanized_farming from era 10 to era 8 without adding an artificial prerequisite.
expected_visual_effect: The line is reduced from six to four era bands.
remaining_risk: A four-era line remains because no closer prerequisite is defensible without broadening scope.

correction: Move field_works to era 8, trench_works to era 9 and add field_works to trench_works.
expected_visual_effect: An adjacent late fortification progression and fewer detached terminal lines.
remaining_risk: Trench works remains a high-degree hub whose routing must be visually checked.

correction: No change; retain as documented exceptions.

expected_visual_effect: Era 11 contains four nodes and the late tree is split evenly 4/4.
remaining_risk: The four remaining era-12 terminals still need auto-layout review.

expected_visual_effect: The visible line drops three bands instead of six and the node rejoins the early/middle society cluster.
remaining_risk: Colonization remains an articulation point for the quinine sub-branch.
